text.content:
r/SeattleAfterDark · Posted by u/night_crane · 3 hr. ago

Anyone else see this on Harbor Island? Pier 46, last night ~2:30

I work nights on one of the container cranes. From the cab you can see the whole pier. Last night, around two-thirty, I saw two guys next to a container. One was hitting the other. But not like a fight. Like a job. Short punches, always in the same spots, no hurry. The other guy wasn't defending himself very well. Then he grabbed him by the neck and hit him once in the chest and the guy… I don't know how to say it. He came apart. Like ash. I swear I wasn't on anything. I went down to look at four when my shift ended and there was a pile of gray dust and nothing else. No blood. No body.

Took a photo from the cab but it's blurry. Posting it anyway.

a dark smudge next to a red container, a figure standing, out of focus, in a long coat
